componentReuse: Module agents inherit the Foundation shell, semantic tokens, resilient states, status patterns, controls, tables and responsive rules. Parallel component libraries or module-specific visual languages are prohibited; durable shared primitives require a reviewed design change.
signalToNoise: Prioritize operational context, exceptions, safety and provenance. Avoid equal-weight metric-card grids, decoration without task value and unexplained totals.
constraints: Use the implemented Operations Ledger tokens and logical CSS properties.
Preserve permission, tenant, location, register, business-date and offline context.
Implement loading, empty, error, denied, stale, approval, offline and conflict states when applicable.
Pass keyboard, visible-focus, semantic-label, contrast, reduced-motion and 200-percent text checks.
Verify English and Bengali, Arabic RTL, CJK, mixed-script, long labels and large numeric values.
Use synthetic or approved test data for visual evidence; never use production customer data.
Do not claim full translation completeness from representative layout fixtures.

extensions.description: Dark operational rail, tenant/location/workspace context, permission-aware routes, offline banner, skip link and responsive horizontal navigation.
A strong status surface for safety, synchronisation and the few facts that change the user's next action.
Risk-ordered operational work with bounded internal scrolling, explicit states and labelled row actions.
Provenance chain from source through decision to ledger or posting effects; important numbers must remain explainable.
Barcode/search-first product area, keyboard-oriented filtering, persistent current sale, totals and dominant payment action.
Shared loading, empty, error, denied, conflict and offline states with semantic live regions, recovery copy and explicit next actions.
